feeds.title: Copper Sky Renovations Blog
feeds.description: Our team excels at major renovations, kitchen and bathroom remodeling, home additions, ADUs, and specialty projects with a minimum investment of $100,000. Living in Atlanta and looking for home remodeling and home design ideas, the remodeling blog can be a great aid.

feeds.title: Lesley Myrick Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Lesley Myrick is a recognized design media personality and the CEO of her eponymous full-service luxury interior design firm. Lesley specializes in designing personality-driven, playful, and function-forward forever homes. In the interior design blog, Lesley Myrick posts about interior design, personal style, decorating, and home styling tips.

feeds.title: HR Staging & Design Blog
feeds.description: At H&R Staging & Design, we know the Atlanta market. As a full home staging service, you can count on our expertise and local market insights. Our goal is to create an impression of the home that is upscale and contemporary to a wide range of buyers. You can read the latest trends and news from HR Staging and Design on our blog page.

feeds.title: Everly & Monet Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Everly & Monet Interior Design is passionate about design! When they work with clients, they want to provide an enjoyable experience while giving them a space they will love. They are a full-service interior designer in the Washington DC & Atlanta, GA Metro areas. They specialize in designing functional, cohesive, well-styled spaces for moms of busy families.

feeds.title: Joel Kelly Design News
feeds.description: Joel Kelly Design take a holistic approach to design, engaging each client with a renewed sense of discovery. After all, no two clients are the same. Their projects reflect that showing a wide variety of stylistic influences. Our commitment is to you, the client and to a universal level of thoughtfulness and quality.

feeds.title: Design Pulp
feeds.description: Design Pulp aimss to share photos, musings, and people that delight and inspire in the world of design and beyond. We are here to catch your eye and shake up your standards! Consider us your friend who will push you a little and love you a lot. We create beautiful & authentic spaces utilizing sustainable materials & talents of local craftsmen.

feeds.title: Atlanta Magazine » Design News
feeds.description: Atlanta magazine is the city's premier general interest publication, reaching a monthly audience of more than 400,000 readers. Atlanta Magazine is the authority in Atlanta, providing a mix of long-form nonfiction, lively lifestyle coverage, in-depth service journalism, and literary essays, columns, and profiles.

feeds.title: Design Indulgence
feeds.description: The design has always been a passion so I was inspired to follow my dream and start my own business 20 years ago. I live in Atlanta which has some of the best design resources in the southeast. I am married and have 2 rescue Old English Sheepdogs. I love when I get a deal. I like to repurpose my projects.

feeds.title: Mathews Furniture + Design Blog
feeds.description: For over 30 years, family-owned and operated, renowned Mathews Furniture + Design has served the Southeast as THE high-end source for traditional, contemporary, and fine antique reproduction furniture as well as lighting, rugs and accessories. If you need help with your home interior design in Atlanta, they are the one for you.

feeds.title: Erika Ward Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Erika is an Atlanta- based interior designer specializing in new builds, large-scale renovations, and decorating projects. Erika Ward partners with premier brands in the home and lifestyle industry to amplify messages of living well and in style. She manages a full team of professionals to bring forth personalized sanctuary spaces.

feeds.title: Kevin Francis Design Blog
feeds.description: Kevin founded has collaborated with over 50 national brands such as Behr Paint, The Home Depot, etc to produce sophisticated design projects for his followers. His interior design work has been featured in publications including Better Homes & Gardens, Domino, HGTV Magazine, House Beautiful, and more.

feeds.title: Atlanta Homes and Lifestyles » Homes
feeds.description: Published since 1983, Atlanta Homes & Lifestyles is the city's only monthly home and garden magazine. Dedicated to showcasing the best in design for our city, the publication also serves as a definitive guide to cultivating Atlanta style, offering unmatched entrée into the area's most inspiring residences.

feeds.title: Paper and Stitch
feeds.description: Brittni Mehlhoff, the founding editor/art director/stylist of Paper & Stitch started this blog back in 2008 to catalog my inspirations and it unexpectedly became my full-time job. She create lots of DIY content - related to home decor, styling, fashion, and more. Browse Paper and Stitch for organic modern living, hundreds of DIY projects (from home decor to furniture and organization), simple recipes, and unique room makeovers.

feeds.title: Thou Swell
feeds.description: Welcome to Thou Swell, an Atlanta interior design & lifestyle blog curated by emerging designer Kevin Francis O'Gara, sharing original home decor projects, entertaining inspiration, decoration tips, travel guides, gardening, and a fresh spin on Southern style. Thou Swell has become a destination for interior lovers and entertaining enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Kandrac & Kole Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Kandrac & Kole's team brings together signature colors, professional experience, and an eye for detail that make Kandrac & Kole the top Atlanta interior designer. As industry experts in residential and commercial design, they share upbeat and entertaining narratives regarding their design projects, travels, and personal stories on their popular blog.

feeds.title: Southern Hospitality Blog
feeds.description: Rhoda is from Atlanta, GA and she loves decorating and DIY projects. She believes that decorating a home doesn't have to cost a fortune and has spent years thrifting at antique markets and yard sales, finding those treasures that make a home unique. She is here to inspire and encourage other women to find their own inner creativity.

feeds.title: V. James & Co. Interiors Blog
feeds.description: V. James & Co. Interiors specializes in seamlessly tying old and new styles together to create a new design experience for our clients. Their design style can be best described as an eclectic and curated look that incorporates the use of color and texture to accentuate the overall feel of a space. They create a company that is uniquely ours and that exemplifies our commitment to quality work and exceeding our clients

feeds.title: JLS Designs Blog
feeds.description: Jennifer's design work has transformed homes, schools, and office suites across the southeast region. For the past 20 years, Jennifer has been guiding clients from initial design to the final installation making projects low-stress, timely, and on budget. She offers her wisdom & guidance about custom window treatments and interior design through her blog.

feeds.title: William T. Baker Blog
feeds.description: The hallmarks of his architecture are extraordinary attention to detail in craftsmanship and construction, and a keen eye for scale and proportion. Join him here for thoughts on design trends, recent projects, & related items of interest. Read our blogs to know about the latest designing tips, news and more.

feeds.title: Carla Bethany Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Carla Bethany Hayden is an Atlanta-based Home Decor Blogger. She started Carla Bethany, a home and design blog, as a way to share her passion for exploring home interiors and the beautiful objects that fill those spaces. Her designs are influenced by bright colors, patterns, mid-century, palm springs, plant life, and most definitely the homes of the South.

feeds.title: Merge Home Blog
feeds.description: At Merge Home, they invite you to mix, match, and combine styles from different eras, genres, and aesthetics to create your own unique look. As you explore our store, their Merge Interior Design team is always available to talk through your interests and goals and point you in the right direction. Read tips and tricks for interior design, home furnishings, and the best in custom furniture on our blog.

feeds.title: Morse Design Blog
feeds.description: The author of the blog is passionate about interior design because it allows me to be expressive without using words. She love creating beautiful interiors that communicate the vibe of those who inhabit the space, where they can truly live. Life can be messy and having a haven to come home to is important for both myself and my clients.
